name: mp-01-wiesn
why: Likeness from observed photos: receding slicked-back hair in a small bun, long pointed blonde-grey goatee, rimless glasses with orange temples, heavy muscular build.
prompt: Photorealistic candid photograph of a powerfully built German man in his mid-forties walking down the wide stone steps beneath the colossal bronze Bavaria statue at the Theresienwiese in Munich. Distinctive appearance: a markedly receding hairline with ash-blonde greying hair pulled tight and straight back, gathered into a small low bun at the nape; a long, pointed blonde-grey goatee and moustache, the chin beard tapering well below the jaw; rimless eyeglasses with thin orange and black temple arms; a small stud earring. Heavy-set muscular build, very broad shoulders, thick neck, barrel chest, a slight softness at the waist, roughly 1.85 m. He wears a plain black long-sleeved button shirt with the sleeves turned back over thick forearms, slim black jeans and black leather boots. Mid-stride, one hand on the stone balustrade, looking out over the fairground with a faint half-smile. Behind and above him the green-black bronze of the Bavaria and the columns of the Ruhmeshalle. Below, the Oktoberfest in full swing: rows of huge beer tents with painted facades, flag poles, a Ferris wheel, dense crowds in Tracht. Bright overcast daylight, soft even light. Shot on 35mm, natural colour, sharp on the man.
